extName.message: Mnemoloci - save to your second brain

extDescription.message: Saves the page or the selected text to your Mnemoloci second brain (local server or over Tailscale).

injectionWarning.message: Warning: it contains phrases addressed to an AI.

selectTextFirst.message: Select some text on the page first.

errNotPaired.message: Extension not paired: open the options and enter a pairing code.

errNotPairedShort.message: Extension not paired: open the options.

errUnauthorized.message: This browser is no longer authorised: pair it again from the options.

errPrivateAddress.message: Local-network page: saving the text you see.

errFetchFailed.message: The server cannot download it: saving the text you see.

errInjection.message: The text seems to contain instructions for an AI.

step1.message: On the PC, start the server:

step2.message: In the Mnemoloci app: Status → "Generate pairing code", or run python -P -m mnemoloci remote pair

step3.message: Type the code here (valid for 10 minutes, one use)

paired.message: Paired: you can save pages from the extension button.

pairedNow.message: Paired. Now use the Mnemoloci button in the browser toolbar.

serverNoPairing.message: The server does not accept pairing: start it with `remote serve`.

disconnected.message: Disconnected. Also revoke the device from the app (Status → Phone access).
